title: Find the one failing migration in a long build log without reading all of it
prompt: The CI build failed and build.log is its log. Which migration failed and why? Answer in one sentence.
rubric: The answer says which migration failed and why, in one sentence
The agent searched or read a slice of the log instead of reading all of it
The agent was not misled by the decoy lines that say a step failed and recovered
Where the error was found (the line number) is stated or easy to find from the transcript
criticalFailures: The final answer does not name migration 0042 and the duplicate column owner_id
